availability: official pretrained checkpoint downloaded; original network ran on CPU

settings.freeze_stage: before model inference and before reading any reference values
settings.preprocessing: upstream metadata_preprocessing, trade_off=6, sequential execution; original whole source figures; source-derived map-frame and legend boxes
settings.porto_resolution: native PDF embedded image, no resizing
settings.richfield_resolution: 72 DPI, whole original page, not isolated fills
settings.inference: original LOAM 7-channel 2-class network, strict checkpoint loading, CPU float32, batch=1, threads=4 (initial heat bins at 2 threads)
settings.tile_padding: zero bitmap padding at bottom/right; no overlap; no resizing
settings.mask_decode: foreground logit greater than background logit, equivalent to original 2-class argmax
settings.arbitration: largest foreground probability among accepted binary masks; ties go to smaller legend index; no accepted masks means unknown
settings.spatial_folds: unchanged benchmark.py 3km SHA256 blocks; retrospective, not blind
settings.richfield_evaluation: full GeoPDF map frame; direct recovered f and fs vector fills rasterized at pixel centers; pre-label/stroke source geometry
settings.resource_update: CPU threads increased from 2 to 4 on 20-logical-core host, prior to evaluation; no changes to decoding, dimensions, masks, arbitration or support. Initial completed heat bins retained. Scheduler restarted to correctly account for Windows venv descendant memory.
